claims: Temptation Island Season 2 features four couples testing their relationships against numerous singles in Hawaii.
Temptation Island Season 2 is hosted by Mark L. Walberg.
Temptation Island Season 2 dropped on Netflix in April 2026.
The four couples in Temptation Island Season 2 are Kaylee Needham & Summit Wallace, Sydney McGregor & Mikey Bivens, Scarlett Bentley & Cole Mueller, and Shyanne Blankenship & Jack Mason.
In Temptation Island Season 2, Mikey Bivens bonds quickly with singles.
In Temptation Island Season 2, Sydney McGregor explores a connection with Xzavier.
In Temptation Island Season 2, Shyanne Blankenship & Jack Mason struggle with a "toxic cycle".

Temptation Island Season 2 features singles including women Colleen Powers, Darby Dowdell, Kari Nesheim, Medinah Ali, Carter, Christelle, India, Jesenia and men Ethan, Kai, Kris, Malik, Peter, Preston, Alex Angell, Etay Aroshas, Kalaan "KB" Brown, Deac Conti, Shawn Evans, Chris Grant, Ben Knobloch, Chris Novak, Dominique Price, Jose Rodriguez, Kareem Thomas, Aden Twer.
Temptation Island Season 2 features "final bonfire" decisions where participants decide whether to leave with their original partner, a new single, or alone.
